prior_context.text: Marcus, this is Klein from cardiology pharmacy. I am calling to make sure the new metoprolol dose is clear.

prior_context.speaker: pharmacist_klein
prior_context.text: You are moving to 37.5 milligrams twice daily. Since you have 25-milligram tablets, that means one and a half tablets in the morning and one and a half tablets in the evening.

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: And apixaban stays 5 milligrams twice daily, no holding it before the procedure unless the cardiologist specifically tells me?

prior_context.speaker: pharmacist_klein
prior_context.text: Exactly. Do not stop or skip apixaban on your own. The only routine hold we discussed is lisinopril on the morning of the procedure once the date is confirmed.

prior_context.speaker: pharmacist_klein
prior_context.text: Also, magnesium oxide 400 milligrams nightly for five nights, and no ibuprofen or naproxen while you are on apixaban.

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: Thanks. Please do not call the Cedar Bridge number unless my cell fails.
